audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill, Gnar, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Lucian and the mirror already flipped Level 3 and First item to Skill and 2+ items to Lucian. Level 2 stays Gnar in both directions — the Hyper window is real.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere on Gnar's spacing tools, and the late-game section treats GNAR! as a permanent threat.
audit.why: Hop is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s and Boomerang Throw 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s with the catch reducing it — those are the two timers the whole kite war runs on. GNAR! drops to 30s at rank 3, which changes how a late sidelane duel is picked.
audit.corrected: The Hop and Boomerang figures written into mid and early, the 30s GNAR! into late, and report[5].t rebuilt on real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions absent. Neither layer said Gnar's own CC arms Lightslinger, and Ardent Blaze's speed condition was stated wrongly.
audit.why: Lightslinger empowers Lucian's next 2 attacks whenever a nearby enemy champion is immobilized — Wallop and GNAR! both immobilize, so eating the stun and living pays you back. Separately, Ardent Blaze grants move speed for ATTACKING marked enemies, not on cast, so 'Ardent Blaze's speed helps me dodge' is backwards: it is a chase tool you must land an attack to get.
audit.corrected: Both written into mid; the speed condition also corrected in wants.you[1].

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Even at 3 — you get the full Q-W-E rotation, but Hyper hops reset his spacing every time you E in.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: Even at first item — your Lightslinger DPS spikes, but Rage and his hop spacing still let him dictate the range.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: You out-scale him: sustained double-shots and E resets beat a mini-Gnar who cannot transform — duel when GNAR! is down.

edits.before: Track Gnar’s GNAR! (Mega): Mega all-in near walls — track his rage bar like a cooldown. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track GNAR! (30s at rank 3) and the Rage bar: against a wall it stuns. Wallop and GNAR! immobilize — that arms two empowered autos.

edits.before: Use Ardent Blaze's marked-target speed and E dashes to weave out of Boomerang Throw, never to chase into his Rage bar
edits.after: Attack the Ardent Blaze mark to actually get the speed, then E out of Boomerang Throw — never chase into a full Rage bar

edits.before: Level 1 is a genuine coin-flip — my long auto range and Lightslinger double-tap match his Boomerang Throw poke, and neither of us wants to commit before stats. My one window is level 2: Piercing Light plus a double-shot lets me chunk a mini-Gnar before he has hop spacing or his Rage built. Throw Q through the wave to hit him, weave the empowered double auto, and back out on E. Do NOT walk into the returning boomerang for the slow — that catch is what lets him kite me into the rest of his combo.
edits.after: Level 1 is a genuine coin-flip — your long auto range and Lightslinger double-tap match his Boomerang Throw poke, and neither of you wants to commit before stats. Your one window is level 2: Piercing Light plus a double-shot chunks a mini-Gnar before he has hop spacing or Rage built. Q through the wave to hit him, weave the empowered double auto, and back out on E. Do NOT stand in the returning boomerang — catching it cuts his 16s cooldown, and the slow is what sets up everything after.

edits.before: This is where Gnar takes over, and it's the heart of why this lane is hard. From level 3 on he kites my short marksman range with Boomerang Throw, hops off terrain or minions on Hyper to reset every time I E-dash in, and stacks Rage from outside where my autos can reach. I can't trade evenly because I have no way to stick to him — Ardent Blaze's speed helps me dodge, not chase. At 6 the real danger lands: if he transforms mid-fight, mega-Gnar's GNAR! knock-up/stun or a wall-pin locks my low base HP and his whole combo deletes me before E or The Culling matter. Respect the Rage bar — never all-in when it's near full.
edits.after: This is where Gnar takes over, and it's the heart of why this lane is hard. From level 3 he kites your short range with Boomerang Throw, hops off terrain or minions with Hop (22s at rank 1) to reset every time you E in, and stacks Rage from outside your reach. You cannot stick to him — and Ardent Blaze only speeds you when you ATTACK a marked target, so it chases, it does not disengage. At 6 the danger lands: a wall-pin GNAR! stuns your low base HP dead. But note Wallop and GNAR! both immobilize, and that arms your next two Lightslinger attacks — survive the lock and you get paid.

edits.before: Here's my honest path back: I'm an early lane-bully marksman and Gnar is the rare scaler I do out-DPS once I'm itemized. After Kraken Slayer / Essence Reaver, a straight fight into mini-Gnar is mine — my sustained Lightslinger DPS and E resets out-trade his cooldowns when he can't transform. But that only matters if I survived the kite war even, and one mega-Gnar GNAR! in a teamfight still flips it. So I farm safe through the mid game, take the duel only when he's in mini form with Rage low, and lean on my team to bait or eat the transform. Don't sidelane him alone into a fed mega window.
edits.after: Here's the honest path back: you're an early lane-bully marksman and Gnar is the rare scaler you do out-DPS once itemized. After Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver, a straight fight into mini-Gnar is yours — sustained Lightslinger DPS and E resets out-trade his cooldowns while he can't transform. That only matters if you survived the kite war even, and one GNAR! in a teamfight still flips it — at rank 3 it is back in 30s. So farm safe through the mid game, duel him in mini form with Rage low, and let your team bait the transform.
